symbols.name: OptionsConfigurationOverlay
symbols.summary: Applies present configuration properties to a snapshot and replaces supplied collections in full.
symbols.remarks: This processes an existing configuration tree once. It does not load files, subscribe to reload, or select feature precedence. Use serializable option data with writable public properties.

symbols.name: Apply(T, IConfiguration, IDictionary)
symbols.summary: Snapshots option data, applies supplied properties, and records each winning configuration path.
symbols.remarks: Absent properties keep their prior values. Nested option objects merge recursively. Arrays, standard list/set shapes, and dictionaries bind as complete replacements. A present collection with no bound value becomes empty. Unknown or non-writable option properties are rejected.

syntax.content: public static T Apply(T options, IConfiguration section, IDictionary provenance) where T : class
